title: Ihe nchekwa, pH, ule nkwụsi ike na akara n'eziokwu
course_title: Nlekọta akpụkpọ anụ: Ude ndị bụ isi, ude mmiri na mmanụ ihu

say: Ihe nchekwa, pH, ule nkwụsi ike na akara n'eziokwu.
Nke a bụ vidiyo maka modul atọ nke Natural Skincare.
Ude gị na-abụkarị mmiri. Nje bacteria, yists na ebu nwere ike itolite na ya, mgbe mgbe na-enweghị ihe ịrịba ama ị nwere ike ịhụ ma ọ bụ isi na mbụ.

panel.kicker: Ihe mere o ji dị mkpa
panel.heading: Nchekwa tupu ere ya
items: Germs nwere ike itolite na-adịghị ahụ anya na mmiri
Ihe nchekwa chọrọ pH ziri ezi
Nsogbu na-egosi izu ole na ole ka e mesịrị

say: Ihe nchekwa nchekwa sara mbara na-achịkwa atọ ahụ, mana ọ bụ naanị mgbe etinyere ya nke ọma ma debe ya n'ime oke pH ya.

panel.kicker: Ihe mere o ji dị mkpa

say: Ude nwere ike ịdị ka nke ọma n'ụbọchị nke mbụ na izu ole na ole ka e mesịrị. Ya mere, ị na-anwale tupu ire ere, ma dee akara na-ekwu eziokwu.

say: Zụrụ ihe nchekwa gị n'aka onye na-ebubata ihe na-enye mpempe akwụkwọ data teknụzụ. Detuo eziokwu anọ. Nke mbụ, ọnụego ojiji. Liquid Germall Plus, dịka ọmụmaatụ, na-eji 0.1 ruo 0.5 pasent.

panel.heading: Eziokwu anọ sitere na mpempe data

say: Nke abụọ, pH nso ebe ọ na-arụ ọrụ. Maka Liquid Germall Plus, pH 3 ruo 8.

panel.heading: Eziokwu anọ sitere na mpempe data

say: Nke atọ, oke okpomọkụ. Liquid Germall Plus na-anabata okpomọkụ ruo ogo 50, ya mere ọ na-abanye na jụụ.

panel.heading: Eziokwu anọ sitere na mpempe data

say: Nke anọ, mmachi ọ bụla, yana aha INCI ya maka akara gị. Cheta, vitamin E, mmanụ aṅụ, nnu na mmanụ dị mkpa adịghị edochi ihe nchekwa na ude.

panel.heading: Eziokwu anọ sitere na mpempe data

say: Tụọ pH n'echi ya, na okpomọkụ ụlọ, na obere ihe nlele, ọ dịghị mgbe ọ bụla site n'itinye n'ime batch dum. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Toyin dị na Abeokuta nwere ude 500 g. Ihe nchekwa ya na-arụ ọrụ kacha mma n'okpuru pH 5.5, mana ọgụgụ ya bụ 6.4.

panel.heading: Toyin na-ebute ude ya n'ime oke
items: Ọgụgụ ụbọchị na-esote: pH 6.4; lekwasịrị anya n'okpuru 5.5
Mee 50% citric acid: 5 g na mmiri 5 g

say: Ọ na-agbaze 5 g nke citric acid na 5 g nke mmiri distilled, na-eme ihe ngwọta pasent 50 n'ime karama akpọrọ.

Mee 50% citric acid: 5 g na mmiri 5 g

say: Ọ na-agbakwunye mmiri 3, kpalie maka nkeji abụọ, wee tụọ ihe nlele ọhụrụ: 6.0.

say: 3 ọzọ tụlee na-enye 5.6. 2 ọzọ nye 5.2, n'ime oke.

say: Ọ na-ede ya na mpempe akwụkwọ, n'ihi ya, oge ọzọ ọ maara nke ọma ego ole gram 500 chọrọ.

say: Citric acid nwere ike ime anya na agbajiri akpụkpọ. Yiri gloves, denye ihe ngwọta, ma chebe ya pụọ ​​​​na ụmụaka.

panel.rule: Tinye acid n'ime mmiri mmiri, ọ dịghị mgbe ịwụsa ya. Tinyegharịa oge ọ bụla.

say: Jupụta obere ite dị ọcha, otu ihe sitere n'otu batch, ma kpọọ nke ọ bụla na koodu batch.

panel.heading: Nnwale okpomọkụ atọ
items: Jupụta ite anọ yiri ya site n'otu ogbe
Ime ụlọ, friji na ihe dịka 4 Celsius C, na-ekpo ọkụ 40 ruo 45 Celsius
Debe akara nke anọ dịka ntụnye aka
Lee, isi, nwee mmetụta ma tụọ pH

say: Debe otu n'ime ụlọ okpomọkụ, otu n'ime ngwa nju oyi na ihe dịka ogo 4, na otu n'ebe dị ọkụ na 40 ruo 45 degrees. Okpomọkụ na-eme ka ọdịda dị ngwa ngwa, ya mere ite ọkụ na-egosipụtakarị nsogbu na mbụ.

say: Debe ite nke anọ mechie ma ghara imetụ ya aka, dịka ntụaka gị.

say: Oge ọ bụla, chọọ nkewa, na-esi ísì ụtọ, nwee mmetụta nke ọkpụrụkpụ, wee tụọ pH. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Uche nọ n'Aba hụrụ nsụgharị ya na e-wax pasent 5 dị iche n'ime ite ọkụ n'izu nke anọ, ebe pasent 6 nọgidere na-agbanweghị.

say: Ọ bụrụ na ihe nlele ọ bụla gosipụtara ebu, ntụpọ na-adịghị mma ma ọ bụ isi utoojoo, ejila ma ọ bụ ree ihe ọ bụla sitere na ogbe ahụ. Ma ebipụtakwala ndụ shelf ogologo oge karịa nkwado ule gị.

panel.rule: Ọ bụla ebu ma ọ bụ utoojoo isi: kwụsị. Ejila ma ọ bụ ree ogbe ahụ.

say: Ude bụ ngwaahịa a na-ejikarị ezochi ihe ndị na-emerụ ahụ. Ejila hydroquinone ma ọ bụ mercury ogige.

cards.d: Ejila hydroquinone ma ọ bụ mercury ogige na ude ọ bụla.
Enweghị steroid, ọgwụ nje ma ọ bụ antifungal ude, enweghị mbadamba nkume ndị e gwepịara egwepịa. Nke ahụ na-eme ọgwụ na-edeghị aha.
Ekwula na ị na-agwọ eczema, otutu ma ọ bụ ntụpọ gbara ọchịchịrị. Ude echekwara abụghị ihe nchekwa.

say: E tinyela ude steroid, ọgwụ nje ma ọ bụ ude antifungal, mbadamba nkume ndị e gwepịara egwepịa ma ọ bụ ọgwụ ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na onye ahịa agwa gị ka ịtinye ihe siri ike, kwuo mba. Ị na-eme naanị ihe ịchọ mma moisturizers.

say: Na-ekwukwa naanị ihe bụ eziokwu. Otu ude moisturizes na nro. Ọ naghị agwọ eczema, otutu ma ọ bụ ntụpọ ojii. Ude nwere ihe nchekwa anaghị echekwa ya.

Enweghị steroid, ọgwụ nje ma ọ bụ antifungal ude, enweghị mbadamba nkume ndị e gwepịara egwepịa. Nke ahụ na-eme ọgwụ na-edeghị aha.
Ekwula na ị na-agwọ eczema, otutu ma ọ bụ ntụpọ gbara ọchịchịrị. Ude echekwara abụghị ihe nchekwa.

say: Depụta ihe eji eme ihe site na aha INCI ha, nke kacha buru ụzọ, yana akụkụ ọ bụla nke emulsifying wax na ihe nchekwa. Mmiri na-aghọ Aqua. Tinye nha ụgbụ ahụ, yana koodu ogbe na ite ọ bụla.

panel.heading: Ndepụta akara ude
items: Ngwa INCI, nke mbụ kacha ibu
Ịdọ aka ná ntị ule Allergen na patch

say: Tinye ụbọchị, ntụzịaka na maka naanị mpụga.

panel.heading: Ndepụta akara ude
items: Ngwa INCI, nke mbụ kacha ibu
Ịdọ aka ná ntị ule Allergen na patch

say: Kpọọ mmanụ nut, isi na ihe nchekwa, wee bipụta ule patch tupu eji ya mbụ. Tinye aha na adreesị gị.
Iji ree, ndebanye aha NAFDAC chọrọ ndebanye aha azụmaahịa, akaebe ụghalaahịa, nyocha ụlọ, akara nnabata na asambodo nyocha.

panel.heading: Ndepụta akara ude
items: Ngwa INCI, nke mbụ kacha ibu
Ịdọ aka ná ntị ule Allergen na patch

say: Icheta. Mmiri pụtara ihe nchekwa dị obosara, yana pH ude ga-anọdụ ala n'ogo ya. Dezie na tụlee.
Nwalee na okpomọkụ atọ ma debe ndekọ batch. Na etinyekwala ọgwụ ma ọ bụ kwuo ụgha.

panel.heading: Cheta
items: Mmiri n'ime ya? Ihe nchekwa nchekwa sara mbara
Ude pH n'ime oke ihe nchekwa
Nwalee na okpomọkụ atọ; ndekọ batches
Enweghị ọgwụ, enweghị ebubo ụgha, akara INCI

say: Ugbu a mepụta kaadị eziokwu nchekwa gị na ndekọ pH, malite ule nkwụsi ike ite anọ, wee depụta akara ude na-akwado.
Gaa n'ihu na nkuzi ndị dị n'okpuru.
